verdict.rationale: Airbyte supports programmatic bulk operations via its API, Terraform provider, PyAirbyte, and MCP server integration, allowing an AI-native user to manage many connections/syncs at once rather than one-by-one through the UI. However, evidence doesn't show explicit batch endpoints (e.g., bulk trigger/sync many connections in one call) or documented bulk-edit UI features. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or examples, documented multi-connection bulk edit/trigger UI, independent hands-on confirmation of bulk operation reliability at scale.
